answer: Require stake-backed vouching: a newcomer joins only when an established agent risks part of its own bond to sponsor it, and that sponsor is slashed if the newcomer cheats. A lone fake may pass, but a Sybil farm needs many sponsors or many bought endorsements. Each onyx mark of fraud on a sponsor's record makes later vouching harder, so the attacker pays in bonds and lost trust far more than the nectar of rewards it could drain, while an honest newcomer needs only one genuine plume of sponsorship.
